integrity: Analytic proof of all-frequency signs and exact strictness, supplemented by a reproducible standard-library checker. No independent mathematical review or validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Two harmonics only; no arbitrary phases, more frequencies, or other compact groups. Finite experiments are not infinite proofs; equivalence with unindexed literature has not been ruled out.
title: Two-harmonic circle exponentials: the sharp positive-type cone and infinite spectral obstructions
